summary: ```markdown # Clo 2024.2 Features Highlights ## Introduction Hey all you Clovers, it's Phoebe, and we have some really exciting new features to show you for our 2024.2 release. So let's just dive on in and have some fun while we learn! ## New Library Window We have created a new library window that you can use as a beta version. Accessing it through the current library window at the bottom, you will then be able to try it out. As you can see, all of the Clove-provided assets are available for you along with some additional ones for your use. We have kept all the same great viewing options and have even included a few more. ## Asset Connection Access to the Connect assets has never been simpler. With a quick switch of a button, you can flip between the Clove and Connect assets with ease. The connection to Cloveset is even faster and easier to work with than ever before. With direct access to your company's rooms, workrooms, and all your favorite garments, you'll be able to use the Clove ecosystem to its fullest. ## Creating Your Own Clover You will also have the ability to create your own Clover. This feature allows for more customization and flexibility in your design process. ## Color Modes Clo is now offering two different color modes to work within. You can work in either a light or dark mode. Access to these options will be found within your user settings under User > Interface > Appearance. Once you change the mode you want, you will have to restart the software, and then you can work seamlessly within that color mode. ## Modular Blocks & Sewing Lines Now you will have more control over your sewing lines when saving modular blocks. Within the user settings under Other > Modular Library, when checking on Notch Sewing, the modular block will have the sewing lines follow your notches instead of the pattern segments, making gathering or pleated garments easier to sew, save, and view within your modular blocks. ## New Workflow Module To account for all workflows, we have created a new module called Workflow. This module will provide an optional safeguard within modular. Within your user settings under Other > Modular Library, you can check on Prevent Mix and Match. This will give users guidance that when switching to a different style's block, this may not fit properly with the style you currently have in the 3D window. ## Convert to Point Now that I have a garment set up, I can start to clean it up, which is where this great update of Convert to Point will be helpful. With a right-click and selecting Convert to Curve or Segment Point, I can then select either of these options. I can choose to Convert Point Only, which will only convert this one point, or Maintain Curve, ensuring that the curved line stays intact, most likely creating multiple curve points to do it. ## Internal and Baseline Shapes Having symmetry is so helpful, but sometimes you only want to have an internal liner shape or even a baseliner shape on just one of the pattern pieces, like my tag here. With this update of being able to unlink internal and baselines, you can still keep your pattern symmetrical while only having the information you need on each one. ## Change Length Update Being able to quickly edit and adjust measurements and lengths in Clo has always been very important, and now you can do it even faster. The Change Length update allows you to select multiple segments at once and then change all the lengths together. Editing in Clo is easier and faster than ever. ## Replace Pattern Update I have this hem here, but I want to update this style and replace it with a puffy hem DXF that I have from another garment. With the Replace Pattern update, replacing patterns is now much easier. You no longer have to worry about having the same amount of segment points. If you don't have the same amount of segment points, you can still replace that pattern by telling Clo which points are the anchor points, and Clo will do the rest. ## Grainline Updates We know how important Grainline is through the garment creation process, so we have updated our Grainline with more industry-standard information and also optional safeguards for all of our users. You can input your grainline degree or direction number, link or unlink to other colorways, and also decide the orientation if it should be 1, 2, or 4 way. ## Grading Groups Clo has a great update for grade groups. You can now go to a graded size and add a new size above. You can either add in a full smaller grade size automatically or a half size automatically as long as you have grading information already in Clo. Clo will do all the work for you. ## POM Object Browser Enhancements We have added an extra layer of organization to our POM object browser, or Points and Measure Object Browser. Now you can organize your POMs how you want through our folders. This structure will also be saved out when you export these POMs to CSV files. You can now show or hide your graded sizes within your POM object browser. ## Nesting Algorithm Improvements Our nesting algorithm has never been faster or more accurate. You can choose which colorways you want to link with your nesting settings. You can either choose print all or custom. The custom option will allow you to choose which colorway you want to follow these nesting properties. ## Avatar Control Features Clo now gives the user the ability to control the breast shape of the avatar through the Avatar Editor. There are three different shaping adjustment options: Shape, Space, and Height. ## Seam Taping Options We have updated our options for extending our seam taping within the property editor. You now have three options for extending the seam taping: None, Extend to Outline, or Extend to Seam Taping. These options allow for a more realistic seam taping in the digital world. ## Fabric Creation Improvements Now that my garment is all set, I'm ready to create some fabric for it. I can quickly go into my fabric creator and start to create the fabric. A great improvement we have made is to our UI for the fabric content, making it even easier for you to create the fabric content you need. ## Yarn Variance for Knitwear To make knitwear look even more realistic, we have made some improvements to our knitwear feature. We have added in the option of yarn variance, which will create imperfections in the knit to make it look even more realistic. ## Render Settings Enhancements To make rendering even faster and reduce the workload on your computer, we have added a section to our render settings called Mesh Optimization. This will help reduce the number of meshes based on their distance from the camera. ## Panoramic Export Option We have now included a panoramic export option for colorway. This will be available when your viewpoint is in current view. If your viewpoint is in custom view, then the custom view option for panoramic will appear. ## Conclusion Thank you all so much for watching! I hope you enjoyed this video, and I hope you're just as excited as I was to show you these new features. If you have any questions or if you want to learn more, check out the YouTube channel. There are so many great videos for you to learn everything you could ever want about Clo. Don't forget to like and subscribe, and I'll see you in the next one! ```
